# Cully v0.11.2

Patch for Team board stuck states and lesson cleanup.

- Task owners can cancel their own active or blocked work after lease expiry without reclaiming first.
- Expired review packets report stale; maintainers can force-release someone else's review, or an expired active/blocked claim, back to ready.
- Deleting a lesson removes its dependent playbooks.
- Unknown workspace actions are not treated as writes when selecting MCP/CLI tools.

Upgrade: install the v0.11.2 CLI and redeploy MCP/data images at the matching tag. No new migration.
